author: Matt Harvey
title: Calendar of Events for Thursday | Harrison Calendar | wvnews.com
text:
Through Nov. 8
Carolyn Hilliard Art Exhibit, 11 a.m.-3 p.m., hosted by the West Virginia Black Heritage Festival at the Kelly Miller Community Center, 408 E.B. Saunders Way, Clarksburg. Questions, text 304-476-1434.
Through Nov. 20
Pita Piata sale at St. James Church, 2107 Pride Ave., Clarksburg. Baking Wednesdays and Thursdays. Pick up at noon on baking days. Orders: Patti, 304-623-4085; June, 304-622-2808; Tonda, 304-622-3385.
Thursday, Nov. 6
The Hoppers in concert, 7 p.m., Simpson Creek Baptist Church, 231 W. Philadelphia Avenue, Bridgeport. Doors open 6 p.m. Love offering taken. For more info, call 304-842-3589.
Friday, Nov. 7
First Friday in downtown Clarksburg, 4:30-8 p.m., Christ Episcopal Church. Historic tours of the church. Music by Johnny Raven & veterans with guitars. Craft vendors. Cemetery walking tour, 5:30 p.m. History Museum open, 10 a.m.-8 p.m. Lions Club cake walk, 4:30 p.m., Senior Citizens Center. Clarksburg Model Railroad Club open. Waldomore tours, 5-8 p.m. Art Gallery open at Merchants Bank Building, Main Street, display featuring Charles Riffle, photography; LeeAnn Romeo, watercolors; Sue Hurst, painted gourds; Peter Sequin, landscapes. Mike Spatafore, 304-641-5764.
Clarksburg Lions Club regular meeting, noon, Brickside Bar and Grille, Bridgeport. Jodie Whaley of Hope, Inc. will discuss Domestic Violence Prevention and Support for Victims. Contact Don Niles at 304-629-3575.
Saturday, Nov. 8
West Milford Lions Club pancake breakfast, 8-11 a.m., West Milford Community Center. Pancakes, sausage, or sausage gravy & biscuit. Cost: $9. Veterans eat free. Brooms, mops, dishcloths for sale; 50/50/basket raffle. Gun raffle also will be held. Hilda Clutter, 304-745-4778.
West Virginia Storytelling Guild Youth Storytelling Workshop, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., Frank and Jane Gabor West Virginia Folklife Center on the campus of Fairmont State University. For more information and to register, email Francene Kirk at francene.kirk@gmail.com.
Sagebrush Round-Up with The Round-Up Band, Ridgeline Band. $8 at the door. Doors open at 4, dinners at 5, music at 6. On Bunner Ridge near Fairmont.
Irish road bowling, 1 p.m., Tygart Lake State Park. Free and open to the public. Please bring nonperishable foods for food bank. 202-905-1959.
Quarter Auction and Hot Dog Sale, 1 to 3 p.m., Progressive Women’s Association, 305 Washington Ave, Clarksburg. Fundraiser for GFWC Women’s Club of Clarksburg charities and the PWA. Bring quarters. There will be drawings and a silent auction. Open to everyone.
Sunday, Nov. 9
Bingo, Harrison County Senior Center Ballroom, 500 W. Main St., Clarksburg. Doors open at noon, bingo at 1 p.m. Cost: $20 for 18 games, plus special games, including a coverall with a $500 prize. Funds support the Senior Center’s Kinley Cafe. Donna Stuart, 304-623-6795.
Monday, Nov. 10
West Milford Lions Club regular meeting, 6:30 p.m., West Milford Community Center. Guest speaker: Corps officer from Salvation Army. Sycamore ladies will serve. President Hilda Clutter, 304-745-4778.
Knights of Columbus Council 872 to honor deceased members with a Memorial Mass and dinner, Council Hall, 334 E. Pike St. Mass to begin at 6 p.m., followed by dinner and memorial service for recently deceased Brother Knights. Doug Knight, grand knight, 304-623-1302, to make reservations no later than Nov. 5.
Enlarged Hepzibah PSD regular board meeting, 4:30 p.m., Sun Valley PSD office, 18 Sable Circle, Reynoldsville. Rhonda Beezel, Kevin Short, 304-623-2217.
Friends of the Clarksburg-Harrison Public Library meeting, 1 p.m., second floor conference room, and via Zoom. All welcome. Cecelia Reid, 304-624-9860.
Summit Park PSD public board meeting, 4 p.m., at the PSD office, 100 Coal St., Clarksburg.
Tuesday, Nov. 11
Celebrate Recovery at Clarksburg Baptist Church. Doors open at 6:15 p.m., meeting starts at 6:30 p.m. Bonita Totten, 304-672-1657; Lou Ortenzio, 304-677-8880. Also: louortenzio@gmail.com
National Active and Retired Federal Employees (NARFE) Chapter 1579 meeting, 11:30 a.m., Brickside Bar & Grille, 101 Lodgeville Road, Bridgeport. Federal employees & retirees invited. New members welcome.
Stonewall Jackson Civil War Roundtable, 6 p.m., FOP in Nutter Fort. Guest speaker: Jon-Erik Gilot, curator of the Capt. Thomas Espy Grand Army of the Republic Post in Carnegie, Pennsylvania: Program on Confederate Maj. Gen. David Hunter’s Shenandoah Valley raid and retreat through West Virginia.
Sun Valley PSD regular board meeting, 3:30 p.m., Sun Valley PSD office, 18 Sable Circle, Reynoldsville. Cathy Sparks, 304-623-9609.
Free breakfast for all veterans at Buckhannon Elks Lodge, 47 N. Kanawha St., Buckhannon. Beginning at 7:30 a.m.
Wednesday, Nov. 12
Salem High School Class of 1969 lunch meeting, noon, Bella’s Restaurant. Salem alumni, family, friends. 202-905-1959.
Lost Creek Lions Club meeting, 6:30 p.m., Lost Creek United Methodist Church. Honor club veterans, raffle drawing fundraiser, annual Christmas tree sale plans. Dinner by Carolyn Romine, served by LCUM Women. Details: Davey Wriston, 304-838-0351.
Harrison County Association of Retired School Employees, HCARSE, luncheon, noon, Quiet Dell United Methodist Church. Program: Carol Brown, senior trainer, Tai Chi for health. Reservations: Norma, 304-842-4213; Mary Ann, 304-592-2061.
West Fork Conservation District Board of Supervisors board meeting, 9 a.m., USDA Service Center, Mount Clare.
Thursday, Nov. 13
Roosevelt-Wilson Class of 1957 lunch meeting, noon, FOP Restaurant, Nutter Fort. Alumni, family, friends. 304-566-7397.
November Fatima Rosary Rally, noon, Knights of Columbus Hall, 334 E. Pike St., Clarksburg.
Friday, Nov. 14
Washington Irving High School Class of 1958 Breakfast, 9:30 a.m., FOP, Nutter Fort.
Sunday, Nov. 16
Stonewood Firefighters Festival Bingo, doors open 11 a.m.; early birds begin 12:30 p.m., Stonewood Fire Department. Advance tickets: $25, at the door: $30.
Monday, Nov. 17
VFW Post 573 meeting, 7 p.m., at the post in Clarksburg.
Millennium Quilt Guild meeting, 6 p.m., Benedum Civic Center, Bridgeport. Details: 304-203-3805.
Tuesday, Nov. 18
Clarksburg Retired Postal Employees meeting, 9 a.m., IHOP Bridgeport, 304-624-4262.
Military Order of Purple Heart Chapter 418 meeting, noon, IHOP Restaurant, 185 White Oaks Blvd., Bridgeport. Porter Southern, 304-584-5906; Harold Wilson, 304-203-5856.
Friendship Circle, 5-6 p.m., Lost Creek United Methodist Social Hall, Lost Creek. Grades K-5. Social issues addressed through games, songs, activities. Topic: Bullying.
Celebrate Recovery at Clarksburg Baptist Church. Doors open at 6:15 p.m., meeting starts at 6:30 p.m. Bonita Totten, 304-672-1657; Lou Ortenzio, 304-677-8880. Also: louortenzio@gmail.com
Thursday, Nov. 27
Free Thanksgiving dinner, 11 a.m.-1 p.m., New Bethel United Methodist Church, Good Hope. All welcome. Eat in or take out.
Nov. 29-30, Dec. 6-7
Fort New Salem hosts the 51st Spirit of Christmas in the Mountains, featuring heritage skills, caroling, food, and the tree lighting, starting daily at noon.
Tuesday, Dec. 2
Friendship Circle, 5-6 p.m., Lost Creek United Methodist Social Hall, Lost Creek. Grades K-5. Social issues addressed through games, songs, activities. Topic: Cheating.
Dec. 4-7
Buckhannon Community Theatre presents “Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer Jr,” Colonial Arts Center in Buckhannon.
Tuesday, Dec. 16
Friendship Circle, 5-6 p.m., Lost Creek United Methodist Social Hall, Lost Creek. Grades K-5. Social issues addressed through games, songs, activities. Topic: Being a friend.
